game_name: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy
short_description: Influence the fate of the Nusa star system through your clientele’s stomachs. Grow exotic ingredients, create a menu that appeals to intergalactic palates, and discover treasures in the outer worlds. Come on in! The Diner is always open for business.
steam_languages: English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Russian, Turkish*languages with full audio support
